# MNIST Handwritten Digit Classification Configuration
# This configuration reproduces the original MNIST training setup

[dataset]
# Data file paths (generated by mnist.py)
train_images = train_images.mat
train_labels = train_labels.mat
test_images = test_images.mat
test_labels = test_labels.mat

# Dataset dimensions
train_size = 60000
test_size = 10000
input_size = 784         # 28x28 pixels flattened
output_size = 10         # Digit classes 0-9
label_format = integer_indices  # Labels are integers 0-9

[training]
# Training hyperparameters
epochs = 10
batch_size = 50
learning_rate = 0.01

[architecture]
# Neural network architecture
# Format: layer = <type> <input_size> <output_size> <activation>
# Types: dense, residual_dense
# Activations: relu, softmax, none

# Input layer (784) -> Hidden layer 1 (16) with ReLU
layer = dense 784 16 relu

# Hidden layer 1 -> Hidden layer 2 (16) with residual connection
layer = residual_dense 16 16 relu

# Hidden layer 2 -> Output layer (10) with softmax for classification
layer = dense 16 10 softmax
